Because of this, Flapjack and crew are inadvertently led into danger.

6.o: In a scheme to trade wrappers with Peppermint Larry in exchange for candy, K'nuckles and Flapjack search for a "+" because Peppermint Larry says he will give them 100 pieces of candy in exchange for it.

7.o: Captain K'nuckles and Flapjack stow away on a ship that they believe will take them to Candied Island. Instead, they end up on the mysterious Cammie Island; Flapjack befriends the misunderstood (and lonely) monster of the island.

8.t: Shave and a Haircut, Two Friends
8.o: When Captain K'nuckles believes he has found a map to Candied Island, he wants Flapjack to read it to reach their destination. However, Flapjack (in dire need of a haircut) cannot. They go to Doctor Barber for a haircut, only to find that the barber has stolen the map.

9.o: When Flapjack thinks he's unable to tell directions, he and K'nuckles decide to go to school. But K'nuckles finds himself unable to keep up with the other students and later plans to steal the candy rewards that the teacher gives out. However, he finds out something strange about the school.

10.o: When they assume that Bubbie has been kidnapped by a group of foreign sailors known as the Snarks, Flapjack and K'nuckles sneak aboard their ship to locate her.

11.o: Flapjack and Captain K'nuckles suffer from a severe case of foot burn (sunburned feet) after sleeping in the sun. On their quest to treat it, they discover a hideous trolley driver whom K'nuckles knew from his past.

12.o: Captain K'nuckles is accused by a pirate captain of stealing his hand, leading Flapjack to believe that K'nuckles is nothing but a liar. This puts a strain on their friendship, causing everyone else believes that K'nuckles stole from them.

13.o: For Flapjack's birthday K'nuckles, Bubbie, and Flapjack sail west in search of Candied Island.

14.o: Flapjack adopts a rat he rescues from a flood and names it K'nuckles II, but his new pet ends up infecting everyone in Stormalong with the plague.

15.o: Flapjack, Captain K'nuckles, and Bubbie journey to the Bottom of the World to reclaim K'nuckles' long-lost "sittin' muscle" (his buttocks).

16.o: When Captain K'nuckles believes he has accidentally cursed Flapjack with the inability to speak he tries to find a cure, only to discover it to be a ruse by Flapjack to attend the local Knot Festival.

17.t: Lookin' for Love in All the Wrong Barrels
17.o: After relating a tale that reveals why he doesn't trust women Captain K'nuckles ends up falling in love with his own reflection, believing it to be a beautiful woman.

18.o: When Peppermint Larry hosts his annual Adventure Beard-Off Contest Captain K'nuckles enters the contest, with Flapjack pretending to be his beard.

19.o: Flapjack finds out Peppermint Larry is preparing for the Stormalong Pun-Off, in which he will compete against comedy legend Punsie McKale. After Flapjack and Larry are knocked out by Punsie's puns, K'nuckles steals the show.

20.o: Flapjack learns to balance a board on the waves (surfing) and becomes Stormalong's biggest film star.

21.o: Flapjack and Captain K'nuckles get stranded on an island inhabited by a mechanical genie; after fishing for food, they discover that not everything is as it seems.

22.o: Captain K'nuckles tells Flapjack that the more enemies an adventurer have, the greater adventurer he is. This results in Flapjack going on a quest to make enemies and all his plans backfiring.

23.o: Desperate to find a younger sibling after Captain K'nuckles calls him "a baby" out of annoyance, Flapjack asks Bubbie where babies come from and mistakenly adopts a duck as his new "baby brother".

24.o: When the Candy Barrel is shut down by the Dock Hag due to a misunderstanding, Peppermint Larry tries his hand at puppetry. He eventually finds success with "The Amazing Adventures of Pancake" – a spoof of Flapjack and his adventures, much to Flapjack's dismay.

25.o: Believing K'nuckles to be a bad influence Bubbie tells Flapjack to stop following the pirate, but to lead him instead. Unfortunately, after taking the advice of an animal trainer Flapjack accidentally hypnotizes K'nuckles into believing he is a seal.

26.o: When Bubbie sends Flapjack and K'nuckles to get shelf polish on the "bad side" of town, they get into trouble with a group of alley kids and ultimately are challenged to a dance-off to get their possessions back.

27.o: Flapjack denies he is in love with Sally Syrup, despite the little red hearts that pop up around his head.

28.o: Bubbie falls in love with a whale named Harvey, who kidnaps Captain K'nuckles and Flapjack to work in his factory on Laundry Island – unknown to Bubbie, who thinks they are ignoring her.

29.t: Sea Legs (Too Big for His Britches)
29.o: After Flapjack finds a pair of legs adrift at sea, Captain K'nuckles uses them to terrorize the people of Stormalong Harbor. However, when a sea monster's torso comes to reclaim the legs a battle for ownership ensues.

30.o: Flapjack is told by Bubbie the origin of his name before getting his first "special flapjacks". However, Captain K'nuckles forbids Flapjack from eating pancakes without syrup and the two set out to solve the recent syrup shortage.

31.o: When Flapjack discovers some fresh fruit (which hasn't been seen in years) and Captain K'Nuckles eats it, the two head to an island to get some more but a mysterious plant man keeps getting in the way.

32.o: The Dock Hag catches Flapjack and Captain K'nuckles littering and sentences them to community service collecting fish heads. Doctor Barber offers to pay them for the heads (much to their delight), but they soon discover his true intentions for the fish heads.

33.o: Flapjack keeps getting mistaken for a girl so he and Captain K'nuckles attempt to literally "man him up", only to discover that his voice is the problem.

34.o: Captain K'nuckles steals a mermaid queen's heart filled with wishes (in the form of candy) so he and Flapjack can go to Candied Island, but they quickly misuse the wishes and learn a terrible secret about the mermaid.

35.o: Flapjack and Captain K'nuckles are swindled by a mysterious man named Ben Boozle and are forced to work on his ship until Flapjack can achieve the rank of captain.

36.o: Flapjack and Captain K'nuckles sneak aboard a candy cruise ship, but accidentally anger Poseidon when they destroy the ship's figurehead.

37.t: My Guardian Angel is Killing Me!!
37.o: Flapjack is dubbed Captain K'nuckles' guardian angel by Bubbie but when Flapjack annoys him with constant protection, K'nuckles fakes his own death to have peace.

38.o: When Captain K'nuckles and Bubbie read Flapjack's secret diary, Flapjack decides to live like a hermit on a remote island to keep his secrets safe.

39.t: Diamonds in the Stuff (Down the Drain)
39.o: Taunted by a rich boy for being poor, Flapjack and Captain K'nuckles search for diamonds that the rich boy claims are in the sewers of Upper Stormalong Harbor.

40.o: Flapjack learns from Captain K'Nuckles about a strange man who trades combs in exchange for candy. After finding the man's family is in a similar situation to his, Flapjack helps the man (Tee Hee Tummy Tums) sell his combs.

1.o: Take an amazing journey to discover how children evolve their identities from a blank canvas.

2.o: Follow the remarkable transformation of helpless newborns into children, able to move their bodies like no other animal on the planet.

3.o: Explore how children build relationships, from first bonds to true friendships.

4.o: Gain a deeper understanding of how children learn about emotions, as well as the ability to control them by age five.

5.o: From a newborn's first cry to pointing, babbling, and speaking, see how children, including the deaf, learn to communicate.

6.o: Follow every step of the journey as children learn to use their brains to solve problems and invent fantasy worlds.

1.o: When yoga influencer Joy finds out she’s being stalked, she resorts to the Osiris Agency, which sends celebrity fixer Tony Tabet to take care of the matter.

2.o: Tony is tasked with taking celebrity Chris Al Hani to his concert, but their journey goes sideways with every stop sending them deeper into trouble.

3.o: Tony and his new trainee Mike are sent to retrieve an actor who has been kidnapped by gangsters while conducting research for an upcoming role.

4.o: Tony, Sarah and Mike help young superstar June deal with her sleazy music producer Willy Deeb on the set of her new music video.

5.o: Mike and Sarah have the task of getting a USB from eccentric artist Melody. But inside her house, they find themselves trapped in her strange dream-like world.

6.o: While spending quality time with his son, Tony gets a call from pop megastar Maritta. She needs his help confronting dodgy thrift shop owners.

7.o: As he bids Osiris goodbye, Tony and Sarah are blindsided by the sins of their past.

8.o: Finale - On a starless night, Sarah and Tony find themselves facing loss.

1.o: The series premiere of the drama about six talented young lawyers who work on opposite sides of the law and handle the most high-profile and high-stakes federal cases in the country.

2.o: The six young lawyers are determined to bring home wins during their second round of cases; Jay must set aside his personal feelings as he defends a client with controversial beliefs; Sandra's idealism leads to an important lesson from Ms. Krissman.

3.o: Sandra and Kate go head-to-head on a high-profile case involving a young woman accused of leaking classified information, but they learn to find common ground in their fight for justice and pursuit of the common good. Allison struggles to make a case for her client as the courts look to new technology to avoid bias, and Leonard seeks professional legitimacy at the cost of a personal relationship.

4.o: After Seth learns that the people of his hometown and former elementary school in Lincoln, Nebraska, have become seriously ill due to groundwater contamination, he becomes invested in seeking justice, potentially jeopardizing the future of his career. Sandra, Jay and Allison assist Jill with a potential murder case, but as they grow skeptical of their client, Jill only grows more passionate.

5.o: Judge Byrne finds himself at a crossroads in his career when he presides over a case that requires a disproportionate mandatory minimum sentence. Allison represents a charming defendant in a fraud case while on duty for the first time, and Leonard struggles to decide whether or not to bring charges against a political figure.

6.o: Allison defends a man accused of stealing supplies intended for victims of a devastating island hurricane and goes up against Celia Chavez, a tough Assistant U.S. Attorney for whom losing is not an option. Sandra defends a peculiar client accused of assault, but with an altered view of reality and on the other side, Kate is being sought after by an ATF agent in need of legal advice for an unlikely suspect.

7.o: Leonard is forced to confront some longstanding insecurities when his new high-stakes case leads him to question what is right and what is wrong. Sandra goes head-to-head with Seth who files charges against a daring comedian accused of threatening a U.S. president’s life; and Jay defends a tennis player accused of intentionally throwing a match to help his coach win a bet he placed against him.

8.o: Jill and Roger’s complicated friendship is tested when they finally square off over a DEA raid that left an inmate clinging to life. Meanwhile, Kate is assigned to an animal smuggling case involving the death of an endangered panda; and Jay’s emotions are thrust into a case when he learns his trusting father was a victim in a pyramid scheme.

9.o: Sandra goes the extra mile for a client when she goes up against the FBI and ends up in one of the most unexpected and compromising situations of her young career. Meanwhile, Roger assigns Kate, Seth and Leonard to work on a highly sensitive case after receiving a tip alleging that the governor of New York is trying to illegally sell a seat in the Senate.

10.t: This Is What I Wanted to Say
10.o: Sandra defends a hydrologist accused of spying for the Chinese government, but the similarities between this and a former case she lost has her confidence shaken. Meanwhile, Jay faces his fears and goes up against Kate in a case involving a PTA president accused of selling drugs to students; and Allison receives a tempting proposition from her wine-forger client and Leonard reaches out to Kate for advice that culminates with a surprising confession.

1.o: Sandra, with the help of new investigator Ted, must defend a teenage gamer whose online argument leads to a police raid that ends with the death of a United States senator. A personal connection to the “swatting” case makes Roger determined to charge the teenager to the fullest extent of the law and pushes Kate to her limits in the process. Meanwhile, Jay is tasked with defending New York’s most spoiled millennial from going to jail for her petty crimes.

2.o: Tina faces legal consequences as she defiantly insists on protecting a young boy after his father, a witness in Leonard’s case, has a run-in with ICE agents that could lead to his deportation. Elsewhere, Kate is determined to establish her worth to Roger and takes on a significant murder case involving a prominent New York criminal defense attorney.

3.o: Seth becomes committed to taking an immune international diplomat to trial so he can get out of general crime and onto a more senior unit. Sandra works on a kidnapping case and is convinced the kidnapping was an accident. Meanwhile, Jay is certain that taking a different route to work will determine how successful he will be in the courtroom.

4.o: The team in the public defender’s office takes on the case of a young man accused of strangling a woman to death and are determined to prove him innocent. Meanwhile, Tina and Sandra go head-to-head after a man is arrested while transporting a body part through the airport. Elsewhere, Seth and Leonard grow closer after they are tasked with speaking to a conference of an unusually young group of future lawyers.

5.o: Sandra urges Kate to take on a case against a very powerful and well-respected judge who is accused of wrongfully sentencing young children for profit. When Judge Bryne is asked to testify in the case, he questions his role in the rigid justice system and must make a very difficult decision. Elsewhere, Seth temporarily moves in with Jay until a leak in his apartment is fixed.

6.o: Leonard takes on one of the country’s best and most prolific litigators in a case that leads him to grapple with his personal feelings related to race and privilege in America. Back at the public defender’s office, Jay takes on his first drug case, but things heat up when he has to work with a rather unconventional lawyer. Elsewhere, Sandra tries to prove she’s not a workaholic and bonds with Ted over boxing to let off some much-needed steam.

7.o: Sandra is tasked with negotiating a plea agreement for a homeless man accused of trespassing a national wildlife refuge. However, she later suspects that he might have been involved in a more serious offense and enlists Ted to help her investigate. Meanwhile, Roger and Jill’s relationship is tested when the prosecution is forced to subpoena Sandra after learning she may have further knowledge of the crime. Elsewhere, Seth starts spiraling out of control after accidentally stealing evidence in a drug case.

8.o: Allison defends a man arrested for selling illegal cigarettes and is determined to get him released without bail. Elsewhere, Judge Byrne is called to jury duty where his excitement for a chance at experiencing the criminal justice system from another perspective is quickly tempered by the harsh realities of the process. Meanwhile, Sandra is still emotionally recovering after sending her client to prison for murder.

9.o: Sandra and Kate’s relationship is put to the test when they go head-to-head over a high-profile bank robbery case. On the defense side, Alison helps Jay as he decides to take an unconventional approach defending their war veteran client. Meanwhile, Tina gives Roger advice about his relationship with Jill, a relationship beginning to show its cracks.

10.o: On Election Day, Jay turns to Kate and the team for help after his parents and other voters are illegally intimidated at their polling place. Meanwhile, Roger and Jill’s relationship is at an impasse when Sandra learns that they are romantically involved and challenges Jill’s judgement. Elsewhere, Seth gets assigned to the case of a lifetime, but his anxiety increases when he is appointed a bodyguard to help protect him, all while Sandra and Ted take their relationship up a notch.

1.t: The Boy Thought He Was Embarking on a Great Adventure… But, Uh, What’s Going on Here?
1.o: Teenage boy Masato Oosuki was chosen to beta test a new MMORPG, where you're actually teleported inside the world of the game. But once he gets there, he finds his mother has followed him, and she's incredibly strong, too.

2.t: It’s Just a Coincidence They’re All Girls. Got That? Wipe That Smirk Off Your Face.
2.o: Mamako and Masato are now registered as hero and mommy, and they decide to have an interview to decide who’ll join their party.

3.t: Underwear is Armor. Make Sure It’s High in Defense. Otherwise, My Son Might Die!
3.o: Wise joins the party as they prepare to visit the village of Maman on a special quest that Shirase gave them. But first they have to buy equipment, and Mamako is overjoyed at the idea of going shopping with her son.

4.t: Kids Are Kids and Parents Are Parents (but Also Human Beings), and It Takes All Kinds, but They Get Through It Together, Right?
4.o: The "Empress of Night" turns out to be none other than Wise's mother, who she split up with after a fight. When the two of them went their separate ways, the Empress decided to stop playing the game and instead go chasing after attractive men.

5.t: This is a Territory for Children, Filled With Hopes and Dreams. For Children. That's the Important Part!
5.o: Masato, Wise, and Porta become students at Lover’s Lane Academia. Studying here will give them lots of SP and tons of special items. At school they meet a sweet and shy healer named Medhi, and Masato is convinced he’s found the true heroine.

6.t: What a Beautiful Girl... Wait, Not You, Mom. Don't Get Near Me in That Outfit, Stop!
6.o: With Shirase’s help, Mamako is allowed to attend the school as well. Just like Medhimama, she becomes an observer in Masato’s class. When Medhimama finds out that her magic doesn’t work on Mamako, she decides that Mamako is her new rival.

7.t: Students are the Protagonists of a School Festival. But People Wearing School Uniforms are Included, Too.
7.o: The person who’d been whispering her hate about Medhimama was actually Medhi herself. Medhi was loyally doing what her mother told her to, but was secretly feeling extremely stressed and angry. When Masato and his mom find out about this, they decide they want to help her. Meanwhile, the school holds a festival, and parents are allowed to participate. The group decides to open a small café where Mamako will cook. Medhimama opens a café of her own, and insists on competing with Mamako to see who can sell more. Mamako reluctantly agrees, but…

8.t: If I Say Nothing, It Won't Be Heard, But If I Say Something, It'll Be a Critical Hit. It Sucks Being a Family.
8.o: Medhi was able to say what she felt about her mom when Masato was around, but in front of her mother, she always forced herself to act obedient. Wise and Porta both try to cheer her up and be her friend, but Medhimama, who wants a good daughter so that she can become “the number one mom”, refuses to let her have any friends. When Medhi realizes that her mother’s fanaticism was just for the sake of her own ego, she breaks down, lets her feelings loose, and becomes a powerful dragon. The party tries to stop her, but even in the middle of the fight, Medhimama is so obsessed with being number one

9.t: Whoa, There's a Pressure Plate in a Place Like This. Well, I'm Not Stepping On It. No, I'm Saying I Won't!
9.o: Medhi decides to come along with Masato and the party. They all get a notice about a new "tower dungeon", which will grant any wish to those who can get to the top. The party heads to the town of Ommym, where the dungeon awaits. As soon as they arrive, a group of mothers begs them to look for their children. Shirase says that this isn’t part of any event, however. They decide to investigate the dungeon with her. As they get past the traps and the monsters, they’re met by a woman dressed like a gladiator.

10.t: The With Mommy Guild Welcomes All! ...Wait, It's a Bunch of Uninvited Guests!
10.o: The girl who stood in the party's way announced herself as "Amante, Betrayer of Mothers", and told them that she belonged to the rebel group "Ribele". She also told them that she'd gotten the adventurers in town to join her party and help her clear the dungeon. She told them all this despite the fact that they hadn't asked her any of it. The party decided that it needed lots of help to free the adventurers from Amante, and retreated. They opened the "With Mommy" guild, and began to recruit. But Amante's helper, Pocchi, came to stop them. He and his buddies made a certain demand of Mamako, and

11.t: The Courage to Accept Things. A Loving Heart. Also, Full-Body Armor. That's What a Mother Needs... Wait, Armor?
11.o: After being touched by Mamako's motherly kindness, Pocchi and his friends changed their ways and went home to their mothers. As a way of saying thank you, the mothers agree to join the With Mommy guild, and help the party clear the tower. There are still a lot of children who are working for Amante. And so the party, now filled with mothers, heads off to the tower, gossiping and chatting all the way. When this not-very-adventurous party makes it inside the dungeon, they’re met by Amante, who’s gotten sick of waiting for them. She challenges Mamako to… a washing and cleaning contest?!

12.t: I Hoped Against Hope the Wish Would Not Be Granted. But It Totally Was
12.o: Masato's party makes their way up the tower. They meet Pocchi on the way up, who tells them that Amante's plan is to clear the dungeon and wish for all mothers to disappear. They have to stop her! Meanwhile, Amante has made it to the top of the 100 floor tower, and defeated the last boss, but she can't get into the wish-granting room. Masato's party arrives and challenges her to a duel. During the middle of the battle, Amante tells Mamako that her presence here is stealing away her son's future! Mamako is caught off guard. But instead, Masato...

2.o: Emerging from the shadows, a surprise visitor gets Gríma's full attention. As the ground beneath them shifts, Darri and Gunhild heed Katla's call.

3.o: The cold, cruel reality of life in Vík í Mýrdal comes home to Gríma. Darri studies his strange discovery in secret. Gunhild confronts the newcomer.

4.o: Is this a dream or a nightmare? Unsettled, Gríma returns to the camp for answers while Darri heads to Vík for a reunion. A torn Þór grows enthralled.

5.o: A shocking revelation that would ordinarily offer closure instead opens up a chasm of questions. History repeats itself as a deadly ash storm gathers.

6.o: Face to face with an utter mystery, Gríma tries to understand her shadowy find. Rakel has a change of heart as Gísli deals with an unexpected arrival.

7.o: Sometimes shadows have minds of their own. At the scene of the accident, Rakel pours her heart out to Gríma. Darri canvases the crevasse for answers.

8.o: What's real, what isn't — and does it matter? The truth comes out, the fear grows and the mystery threatens to sweep away everything before it.

2.o: Vengeful, Mariam returns to school, but her troubles continue, especially when her bestie deserts her. A clash between Noaf and Layan sparks drama.

3.o: The newly allied Mariam and Noaf set out to take down their first bully at the school's open day. Dina's efforts to fit in lead to a change of heart.

4.o: Rania and Layan vow to make whoever was responsible for Ruqayya's scandal pay. In spite of their success, the misfits argue about the next steps.

2.o: Sarah gets invited to Tasneem's house for a sleepover, but Hiba isn't happy about it. Meanwhile, Nadeen befriends the mysterious Shams.

6.t: If I Could Do It All Again...
6.o: Nadeen teams up with a past rival for a risky mission to save their friend. Farah chases her dream of performing with Tasneem in front of the school.

7.t: The Boy Who Turned into a Bird

2.o: Rawan tries to hide that she knows the truth about Salma’s alleged suicide despite the police interrogations in her building. Marwan’s wife discovers his secret.

3.o: Just as Rawan was about to throw out Salma’s belongings, she receives a threatening call. Ahmad finds a suspicious transaction in Karim’s bank statement.

5.o: A regretful Ahmad asks for Rawan’s forgiveness. Rawan looks into Salma’s belongings in hopes of solving the mystery. Ahmad’s father-in-law tries to sideline him.

1.o: The last most remarkable feat 28-year later. Obstacles were overcome: the pandemic, Maradona's death, and the consolidation of a Technical Director in whom few trusted. Messi has redeemed himself.

2.o: Argentina vs Italy. The champion of the Americas will face the champion of Europe. At Wembley, mythical stadium. Argentina concentrates in Bilbao and revolutionizes the city. The team will seek to maintain its winning record.

6.o: The players are waiting for the final list of the 26 that will travel to play the World Cup in Qatar. The delegation prepares for the trip. Argentina and the whole world want Messi to win this World Cup.

1.o: Yehya, a retired underground fighter and a failed doctor... After his divorce from Noha, he ends up in a modest apartment, working a job he hates, and living with a daughter who’s indifferent to him. Meanwhile, he receives a strange offer from Shabaka to return to fighting, which makes Yehya consult his old coach Tambi about that surprising offer. But Yehia later discovers that he has dementia.

2.o: Yehya decides to train again after learning he has Alzheimer's... which causes Tempy’s return... but after a short period of training, and despite Tempy’s insistence that he’s not ready... Yehya decides to take on a fight, which he loses after suffering a panic attack. He is defeated in front of the committee that selects the fighters for a major tournament being held in Egypt.

3.o: Yahya is depressed after the humiliating defeat he suffered... but his love for the call girl Alya and his dire need for money push him to go back to training… He later discovers that Shabaka has succeeded in using his connections to get him back in the championship... but Yehya fires Tempy from his coaching team.

4.o: Yehya tries to reconcile with Tempi, whose dignity is wounded. He also tries to rebuild his relationship with his daughter after she gets in trouble at school. Finally, he goes out with Alya and meets her daughter for the first time. But in the meantime, his father goes missing.

5.o: Yehya gets notably closer to his daughter, and he confesses his love for Alya as he prepares for the first official match in his life, the result of which surprises Yehya and the whole world...but his father's deteriorating health forces him to move to Nour Aldeen’s house...

6.o: Yehya and Farida are now living in Nour Aldeen’s house… His memory is deteriorating and his daughter is angry again at him because of the move… Alya is afraid of assault for the first time after her friend gets assaulted. She complains to Yehya, which only increases his guilt… This makes him confess an old secret to Tambi... Fueled by anger, Tambi goes to Alya and tells her Yehya's secret.

7.o: Yehya and Alya get into a fight over the secret he’s been hiding from her. Yehya falls into in a state of panic, which turns into anger that fuels his energy in his match against Rafik - the fiercest Egyptian fighter - Yehya takes all his anger out on him.

8.o: Yehya’s ex-wife Noha decides to take Farida to live with her again... This weighs heavily on Yehya who feels very lonely. Unfortunately, Farida finds out about Yehya’s illness which he had kept secret. She insists that he stops fighting.

9.o: It’s the awaited fight between Yehya and the fierce Russian fighter Ulyanov... everyone expects that Yahya would lose from the first round... but Yahya no longer cares about winning or losing... he only cares about walking his path all the way.

1.o: The wedding of Sigrid and King Leif ends in tragedy when Thor unleashes his wrath upon the ceremony, sparking a vow of vengeance from the bride-to-be.

2.o: In the underworld, Loki sets a plan in motion. Sigrid and Leif recruit a band of warriors and launch a quest for weapons made of god-killing iron.

3.o: Odin's huntsmen attack Sigrid's crusaders on their treacherous journey to Vanaheim. Thor and his mortal enemy come face to face in combat.

4.o: To obtain a bushel of enchanted apples for the Vanir gods, the warriors must bloody their swords in a fight against the beast guarding the orchard.

5.o: Leif and Loki find themselves trapped in a cursed realm. A pack of First Wolves aids the warriors. Sigrid's story attracts surprising new allies.

1.o: عقب فوزه بالميدالية الذهبية الأولمبية في روما، يعود كاشيوس كلاي إلى لويفيل بمنظور جديد وحماس بالغ لما يخبئه له الغد. وسرعان ما يجد نفسه مضطراً لتلمس خطاه وسط الشهرة الوافدة، بينما يوازن بين قرارات مسيرته المهنية، وتشابكات العلاقات العائلية، والواقع السياسي والعرقي المعقد لمدينته الغارقة في الفصل العنصري.

2.o: تسابق عائلة كلاي الزمن لتأمين مستقبل كاشيوس قبيل أول نزال احترافي يخوضه. وتُصدم بيرد حين تكتشف أن كاش والفتيان يتخذون القرارات من دون علمها، ما يُحدث شرخاً في العائلة يهدد مخططاتهم برمتها. ومع اقتراب موعد النزال، يصبح لزاماً على عائلة كلاي تنحية خلافاتهم جانباً والعمل لما فيه مصلحة كاشيوس أولاً وأخيراً.

3.o: يبرز سوني ليستون كخصم مرعب في عالم الملاكمة، لكنه يصارع لقطع صلاته بعصابات المافيا. في المقابل، يجد كاشيوس مدرباً في شخص الملاكم الشهير آرتشي مور، غير أن ثقته بنفسه توضع على المحك عندما لا يُبدي هذا الأسطورة أي إعجاب بقدراته. ومع عجزه عن الانصياع لنظام مور الصارم، يجد كاشيوس نفسه مرغماً على الاختيار بين التخلي عن هويته وطبيعته، أو البحث عن شخص يؤمن به حقاً ليصبح الأعظم.

4.o: يتسلق كاشيوس سلم التصنيف لنيل فرصة المنافسة على لقب بطولة العالم للوزن الثقيل، بينما يسحق سوني ليستون كل من يقف في طريقه ويقترب بخطى حثيثة من ملاقاة فلويد باترسون. متأثراً بأحد المصارعين الاستعراضيين، يبتكر كاشيوس لنفسه شخصية علنية مثيرة للجدل، تجلب له اهتمام وسائل الإعلام وتضع حياته الخاصة تحت مجهر التدقيق، مما يهدد بكشف علاقاته المتنامية بحركة أمة الإسلام.

5.o: تقرّب صداقة جديدة مع مالكوم إكس كاشيوس أكثر من حركة أمة الإسلام، بينما يكافح لإبقاء عقيدته طي الكتمان وبعيدة عن والديه والصحافة. وخلال زيارة مشحونة إلى منزل العائلة، تتزايد شكوك كاش وبيرد بشأن المعتقدات الدينية لابنيهما. وفي ميامي، يسابق أنجيلو الزمن لمنع وصول صورة مثيرة للجدل إلى وسائل الإعلام، صورة قد تنذر بتقويض مسيرة كاشيوس المهنية برمتها.

6.o: يسعى كاشيوس وراء حلمه باللقب حتى لندن، حيث يلتقي بالبطل البريطاني هنري كوبر. غير أن غروره وقبضة كوبر اليسارية الصاعقة يطرحانه أرضاً فوق الحلبة. ومع تأرجح فرصته في نيل اللقب وتلاشي أحلام كل من وضعوا ثقتهم فيه، يترقب العالم بأسره ليرى إن كان كاشيوس قادراً على النهوض قبل نهاية العد. وفي هذه الأثناء، يحاول بطل الوزن الثقيل سوني إعادة صياغة صورته أمام الرأي العام.

7.o: عندما تتصدر أنباء انضمام كاشيوس إلى حركة أمة الإسلام صفحات الصحف، يثير الغضب الجماهيري حالة من الجدل تضع النزال على لقب بطولة العالم للوزن الثقيل في مهب الريح. ويحثه والداه ومدربوه وفريقه المعاون، بل وحتى مالكوم إكس نفسه، على النأي بنفسه عن حركة أمة الإسلام لضمان إقامة النزال. يجد كاشيوس نفسه مرغماً على اتخاذ قرار مصيري مستحيل سيرسم ملامح مسيرته المهنية وحياته بأسرها.

8.o: يواجه كاشيوس بطل الوزن الثقيل سوني ليستون في نزال العمر ومحطة مسيرته الأبرز. وبينما ينهال المتحدي المتباهي بالسخرية والاستفزاز على خصمه المهيب، تتصاعد الضغوط فوق كاهله ليثبت أن كلماته ليست مجرد ثرثرة جوفاء. ومع اقتراب حلمه من التحقق، يحبس العالم أنفاسه بترقب ليرى إن كان كاشيوس سيتوج بطل العالم القادم للوزن الثقيل.
